args.description: Deterministic drawing-write tool "rearrange-panels-to-cat-silhouette": takes all existing closed-polyline panel entities on the Panels layer (default layer param "Panels"), preserves every panel (same count, same individual polyline geometry/size — only position/rotation may change, no panels added or deleted), and repositions them so their centroids collectively trace a recognizable sitting-cat silhouette (rounded body mass, two triangular ears, a curved tail) sized to fit within the current drawing extents. Must be deterministic (same input drawing -> same output layout, no randomness). Produces a new immutable drawing version on write. Read-only preview/dry-run should be supported so the proposal can be shown for approval before any write is committed.
